title: Blackout
desc_lfm_album: Blackout is the fifth studio album by American singer Britney Spears, released on October 25, 2007, through Jive Records. Created during a period of intense media scrutiny and personal turbulence, the album represents Spears' most radical artistic statement—a cohesive fusion of dance-pop, electropop, and synth-heavy production that would fundamentally influence the direction of mainstream pop music. Spears served as executive producer, collaborating with a new generation of producers including Danja, Bloodshy & Avant, and The Neptunes, who crafted a sonically adventurous landscape defined by distorted vocals, heavy synthesizers, and relentless club-ready beats that embraced digital manipulation as an artistic choice .

desc_lfm_album: MAYHEM is the seventh studio album by American singer-songwriter Lady Gaga. It was released on March 7, 2025, by Streamline and Interscope Records.
